description: A script for generating an 'Inactive Sales Items' report in an ERP system, fetching data about items, territories, and sales details, and formatting report columns and data.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate report columns and data based on filters.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the structure and labels of the report columns.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Fetches and compiles report data based on filters, including item, territory, and sales info.

methods.name: get_sales_details
methods.description: Retrieves sales data with last order date and days since last order, based on filters.

methods.name: get_territories
methods.description: Fetches territory records, optionally filtered by specific territory.

methods.name: get_items
methods.description: Retrieves item records filtered by item group and item code.
